BUCKET.DELETE.summary: Deletes documents from a bucket that match a filter expression.
BUCKET.DELETE.complexity: Depends on the query plan. O(N) where N is the number of documents the plan scans.

reply_schema.description: A cursor ID and the ids of the deleted documents.

cursor_id.description: The cursor ID for BUCKET.ADVANCE. -1 means the LIMIT was reached and the cursor no longer exists.

object_ids.description: The ids of the deleted documents.

items.description: A document id. The encoding follows the session's object_id_format attribute: 12 raw bytes or 24 hex characters.

arguments.name: bucket
arguments.summary: The name of the bucket to delete from.

arguments.name: query
arguments.summary: The filter expression that selects the documents to delete.

arguments.name: count
arguments.summary: The number of documents processed per round trip. Defaults to the session batch size.

arguments.name: limit
arguments.summary: The highest number of documents to delete. Zero means no limit.

arguments.name: spec
arguments.summary: A collation spec for locale aware string comparison in the filter.
